s: Zeman birkat tzitzit ubo g' seipim: en chayyab lehatil tzitzit ella betallit sherotzeh lelobshah, shenneemar: "asher tekasseh bah", abal im eno rotzeh lelobshah — eno chayyab lehatil bah tzitzit, ulepikak haoseh tzitzit betallit sherotzeh lelobsho — lo yebarek kelum bishat asiyya, lepi sheen gemar hammitzva bishat asiyya ella bilbishat hattallit:

Asa tallit letzorek takrikim, ap-al-pi shellobeshah lipamim bechayyayv — en tzarik lehatil bah tzitzit, kevan sheiqqarah enah asuya ella lehitkassot bah beshaa sheppatur min hatztzitzit — have leh kiksut hamyuchedet lallayla sheppatur millehatil bah tzitzit apillu im lobeshah bayyom. Uledibre haomerim shekkesut layla chayyab lehatil bah tzitzit im lobeshah bayyom — hu haddin kan chayyab lehatil bah tzitzit im mitlabbesh bah bechayyayv. Umeachar shello nitbarer lanu halaka kedibre mi — laken yatil bah tzitzit abal lo yebarek aleha:

Mokere kesut muttarim lilbosh tallit sheenah metzuyyetzet, kevan sheen kavvanatam lahanaat lebisha ella kede leharot leloqechim middat hattallit. Abal asur lilbosh tallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kede lehaabir et hammekes, sheen notelin mekes min hammalbushim, shehare neheneh hu bezot hallebisha, umitkavven hu lekak, sheal yede zeh en notelim mimmennu mekes:
